reviews.review:
Hardcore in everyway, this is the only game to make it to #1 hardest game I have ever played and stay there.

PROS:
Everything.

CONS:
The "demon" boss doesn't even do anything, he's just lazy af and stands there while he summons minions to kill you for him. Seriously, wtf?
Fantastic. You can't afford not to buy this game.

been playing for over a year through various steam accounts, and I'm still here. Thats an achievement reserved for games with spell-bindingly glorious difficulty and games with immense replay value. This game is capable of both.

One problem I've had with many roguelites would be the combat. Sometimes they didn't offer the weight and impact that make attacking and killing things feel good.

[i]Risk of Rain[/i] is one roguelite that gets that right. Attacks and explosions come with appropriate recoil and visceral feedback. The game gets this and many other things right.

Each character has four abilities, giving unique flavor and utility to their gameplay. The character diversity gives great incentive for replayability since it'll be necessary to unlock everything. Furthermore, there are TONS of items that all bring creative, diverse effects to your attacks. Some items just buff your stats, but others have more interesting effects such as turning the enemies you kill into temporary ghost allies.

The flow of the game works well, too. You need to kill enemies, get money, power up, and find the exit as soon as possible. The longer you take, the higher the difficulty goes. You'll die a lot, but it's part of the fun and you'll be eager to return.

If there's one complaint I have with the game, it would be the ambiguity with some of the item descriptions. While you can view more detailed effects through the main menu, some of the flavor text can make understanding your items more difficult than it needs to be.

Interesting items, beefy combat effects, and clear risk come together for a great experience. It's definitely one of the best roguelites around.
